{{Top}}
{{Quote|I can't see a thing in this helmet.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:Jango_Fett_helmet_OS.png|thumb|Jango Fett's Mandalorian helmet]]
A '''helmet''' or '''helm''' was a type of protective headgear. The [[Helm of Ieldis]] was an example of a helmet,<ref name="Escape 1">[[Knight Errant: Escape 1|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 1]]</ref> as were the [[clone trooper learning helmet]]s.<ref name="FF92">{{FactFile|92|HEL 1-2|Clone Learning Helmets}}</ref> The [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racer]] [[Blizz Pinnix]]'s true appearance or gender was unknown by the general public due to the racer never appearing without wearing a helmet.<ref name="Wretched">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> While primarily used to protect the head, ancient [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] soldiers cooked [[Uj'alayi/Legends|uj'alayi]] in their helmets.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|277|uj cake}}</ref>

{{Clothes-stub}}
